local_dishes.name: Ceviche
local_dishes.description: Peru's national dish, made with fresh raw fish or seafood 'cooked' in lime or lemon juice, mixed with chili, salt, red onions, sweet potato, and Peruvian corn
local_dishes._legacy_note: same name also exists in Lima

local_dishes.name: Aji de Gallina
local_dishes.description: Creamy, comforting dish made with shredded chicken in rich, mild yellow sauce, served with rice, boiled potatoes, and black olives
local_dishes._legacy_note: same name also exists in Cusco

local_dishes.name: Lomo Saltado
local_dishes.description: Popular stir-fry dish, Chinese-Peruvian fusion with marinated strips of beef, onions, tomatoes, and French fries, served with white rice
local_dishes._legacy_note: same name also exists in Cusco

local_dishes.name: Causa Rellena
local_dishes.description: Cold appetizer featuring layers of mashed yellow Peruvian potatoes with various mayonnaise-based fillings like tuna, chicken, crab or prawns
local_dishes._legacy_note: same name also exists in Lima

local_dishes.name: Papa a la Huancaína
local_dishes.description: Sliced boiled yellow potatoes covered in creamy, spicy cheese sauce, garnished with hard-boiled egg and olives
local_dishes._legacy_note: same name also exists in Lima

local_dishes.name: Locro de Zapallo
local_dishes.description: Hearty, creamy squash stew made with pieces of squash, potatoes, evaporated milk, queso fresco, and vegetables
local_dishes._legacy_note: same name also exists in Cusco

local_dishes.name: Kapchi
local_dishes.description: Traditional Andean vegetarian stew from Cusco region, featuring mushrooms and fava beans, with potatoes and rice
local_dishes._legacy_note: same name also exists in Cusco

local_dishes.name: Quinoa Soup
local_dishes.description: Nutritious soup made with quinoa and assorted vegetables in vegetable broth
local_dishes._legacy_note: same name also exists in Cusco

local_dishes.name: Tacu Tacu
local_dishes.description: Peruvian take on rice and beans, traditionally made with leftover rice and beans, often served with fried egg
local_dishes._legacy_note: same name also exists in Lima

local_dishes.name: Solterito
local_dishes.description: Refreshing Peruvian salad from Arequipa, made with fava beans, corn, onions, tomatoes, black olives, and queso fresco
local_dishes._legacy_note: same name also exists in Arequipa

local_dishes.name: Humitas
local_dishes.description: Sweet or savory corn cakes wrapped and cooked in corn husks, often made with cheese, onions, and spices
local_dishes._legacy_note: same name also exists in Cusco

local_dishes.name: Arroz Chaufa
local_dishes.description: Chifa fried rice with bell peppers, soy sauce, egg, and various meats
local_dishes._legacy_note: same name also exists in Lima

local_dishes.name: Pisco Sour
local_dishes.description: Peru's national cocktail, made with Pisco, lime juice, simple syrup, egg white, and Angostura bitters
local_dishes._legacy_note: same name also exists in Lima

local_dishes.name: Chicha Morada
local_dishes.description: Non-alcoholic traditional drink made from boiled purple corn, pineapple skin, cinnamon, cloves, and sugar
local_dishes._legacy_note: same name also exists in Lima

local_dishes.name: Inca Kola
local_dishes.description: Bright yellow, super-sweet fizzy soda that tastes like bubblegum, more popular than Coca-Cola in Peru
local_dishes._legacy_note: same name also exists in Lima

local_dishes.name: Chilcano
local_dishes.description: Refreshing Pisco-based cocktail made with Pisco, ginger ale, lime juice, and splash of bitters
local_dishes._legacy_note: same name also exists in Lima

local_dishes.name: Mate de Coca
local_dishes.description: Herbal tea made from coca plant leaves, consumed to help with altitude sickness
local_dishes._legacy_note: same name also exists in Cusco

local_dishes.name: Lucuma Milkshake
local_dishes.description: Milkshake made from unique Peruvian fruit lúcuma, known for sweet, caramel-like flavor
local_dishes._legacy_note: same name also exists in Cusco

local_dishes.name: Emoliente
local_dishes.description: Warming herbal tea made from blend of medicinal plants like plantain leaf, alfalfa sprouts, barley, and flaxseed
local_dishes._legacy_note: same name also exists in Cusco

local_dishes.name: Quinoa Soup (Sopa de Quinua)
local_dishes.description: A nutritious soup made with quinoa, often including assorted vegetables (potatoes, carrots, zucchini, peppers) in a vegetable broth
local_dishes._legacy_note: same name also exists in Cusco
